_comment: Preconfigured sets of timelines for the DQM web application.
Edit this file to add your own, or point DQM_DASHBOARDS at a different
one; it is read when the application starts. See dqm/web/dashboards.py
'groupx/subgroup/namex'. Names are preferred over raw sid/vid numbers:
they say what the series is, and they keep meaning if the database is
rebuilt with different ids. Names are resolved when a dashboard is first
used, so a stale entry reports itself in the application rather than
mode is 'time' or 'run'. window is days or runs; omit it for everything.

dashboards.name: Nightly reco - calorimeter
dashboards.description: Cluster energies and multiplicity from the nightly reco validation

dashboards.name: Nightly job resources
dashboards.description: CPU and memory across the nightly validation streams

dashboards.name: CRV calibration - recent runs
dashboards.description: Calibration constants for the first two CRV sectors

dashboards.name: CRV PE yield - all history
dashboards.description: Photoelectron yield per sector, over every run on record
